content.value: Show that the work saved against friction by fitting an air vessel in a single acting reciprocating pump is 84.8%.

l(c) A single acting reciprocating pump runs at 60 rpm. The diameter of the plunger is 0.15 m, crank radius is 0.20 m. the suction pipe is 0.125 min diameter and 5.9 m long. Calculate the maximum permissible value of suction lift, if the separation takes place at 2.6 m of water absolute.
